shared_anchor_diagnostic.selection_policy: Intersect every frozen accepted-target set for the original and equivalent rewrites in the same context; no rank/output-based selection. Subgoals stay separate.
shared_anchor_diagnostic.unknown_policy: Missing original, unknown labels, empty intersection or unavailable scores remain unknown, not zero.
shared_anchor_diagnostic.limitation: Post-hoc within-cohort entry comparison only; the intersection is not a fixed cross-round benchmark target set. A common anchor does not exhaust relevance or prove that a query caused lower E2E cost. Different partial target sets confound direct comparison of primary ranks.
